_comment: Knowledge base the rasvcx_demo safety-regression cases run against. It must be the PUBLISHED version (scripts/publish_kb.py, pointer data/demo_kb/active_version.json) with its persisted Qdrant collection. Benchmarks refuse seed_fallback, a different corpus or BM25 index, and an in-memory dense rebuild (qdrant_mode=memory). Run official benchmarks with the server stopped (embedded Qdrant is single-process).
